title: 29 CFR 1910.303 General
authority: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
used_for: guarding specified live parts through approved cabinets or enclosures; listed or labeled equipment use
material_limitations: Federal workplace standard; applicability and technical determinations depend on the actual equipment and work. It is not a facility-manager repair procedure.

title: 29 CFR 1910.333 Selection and use of work practices
authority: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
used_for: deenergization requirement and qualified-person boundaries for work on or near exposed live parts
material_limitations: Federal workplace standard; article does not infer voltage, energized state, deenergization, or universal approach distance from an open door.

title: 29 CFR 1910.335 Safeguards for personnel protection
authority: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
used_for: protective equipment, shields, barriers and warning techniques around electrical hazards
material_limitations: Federal workplace standard; site procedures, employer duties, qualified evaluation and emergency authority instructions control the actual response.
